limitations.title: Heavy client runtime
limitations.detail: Wix pages ship a large JS runtime that delays interactivity, especially on mobile.

limitations.title: No code or hosting export
limitations.detail: Wix does not export site code, so the site cannot be moved without a rebuild.

limitations.title: Generated IDs and markup
limitations.detail: comp-xxxx IDs and absolutely positioned wrappers make the markup hard to maintain.

manualRebuild.title: Wix apps and Velo code
manualRebuild.detail: Wix apps (bookings, members, stores) and any Velo code do not carry over and must be rebuilt.

manualRebuild.title: Wix form submissions
manualRebuild.detail: The form backend must be set up manually.
